title: McGill 1993: centroid distance of multifidus at L1-L2 (M, supine)

imaging.modality: MRI Philips Gyroscan, spin echo TR 500 TE 20
imaging.plane: transverse slices (scanner axial, trunk in anatomic supine position); for each level the slice closest to the disc centre (within 5 mm)
imaging.level_definition: disc level: column labelled with the vertebra above the disc (e.g. "L3" = L3/L4), inferred from Table 5 which uses disc labels

quantity.name: centroid_distance
quantity.definition: distance from the vertebral-body (or disc) centroid to the muscle area centroid in the image plane; AP signed (+ anterior, - posterior), ML unsigned lateral distance. NOT a true moment arm

source.authors: McGill SM, Santaguida L, Stevens J
source.sample: 15 young men; healthy, no history of disabling back disease

how_to_simulate: Pose the model supine with knees extended.
Cut a transverse plane (perpendicular to the body long axis) through the L1-L2 disc centre.
Take the PCSA-weighted centroid of multifidus on each side; report Y (AP, + anterior) and |X| (lateral) from the disc centroid.
Compare per side. Raw centroid distances (uncorrected), not moment arms.

subject_model.source: Methods (SD age 3.6, weight 10.7, height 6.8); disc area Table 2

protocol.notes: Raw (uncorrected) distances measured in the slice.

data.note: printed negative for the left side; stored unsigned

extraction.check_notes: Every cell transcribed from rendered pages 175-176 (PDF text layer is OCR-garbled); re-checked column alignment against the column headers.
